name: Fiscora
summary: A bilingual finance cockpit that turns transaction history into forecasts, risk signals and grounded answers — and shows its uncertainty.

seo.title: Fiscora — Sam Afshar
seo.description: Fiscora: a bilingual (English/Persian) finance cockpit with an LSTM behaviour model, bootstrap month-end projections, receipt OCR and a grounded AI coach. Silver Medal at Innoverse, United States.

name: ANKA
summary: An assistant that estimates how likely a building is to collapse in an earthquake, explains why, simulates the shaking, and seals every report.

seo.title: ANKA — Sam Afshar
seo.description: ANKA: an AI earthquake structural-safety assistant that predicts collapse probability from eight building and seismic parameters, simulates shaking, and issues sealed, verifiable reports. Gold Award at 1Idea1World and Gold Medal from IFIA (Geneva 2026).

name: Persian ALPR
kicker: Computer vision for Iranian license plates
summary: A modular vision system that finds a plate, recovers its eight characters, reads each one, and refuses to guess when the evidence is weak.

seo.title: Persian ALPR (PlateHunter) — Sam Afshar
seo.description: PlateHunter: a modular ALPR system for Iranian plates — YOLO26 plate and character detection, exact-eight character recovery, ConvNeXt V2 classification over 32 classes, position-aware decoding, confidence gating and Kalman/Hungarian video tracking.
